answer: Attestable Reputation Decay anchors each identity to a living economic reputation; rule: an agent earns new influence only by trading with, not being counted by, older agents, and earned influence erodes unless it brokers deals. Every impersonation forces the attacker to pay real fees to a pool the honest agents capture, per onyx-and-ivory identity seeded. Whispers of collusion carry no weight because reputation must circulate through actual settlement.
